title: Create Alembic migration for voice preferences
description:
Create migrations/versions/0009_voice_prefs.py implementing a reversible Alembic migration that adds voice preference columns (or creates the voice_preferences table) matching the model changes from task r.3.

This migration must:
1. Use the correct Alembic revision chain — inspect the real head revision number before generating (do not assume 0008 exists; check migrations/versions/). The filename 0009_voice_prefs.py is a placeholder. Determine the correct next revision sequence number.
2. Add voice preference columns or create the new table as defined in chatbot/db/models.py from task r.3. If columns are added to an existing table, use ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN patterns. If a new table, use create_table.
3. Be reversible: the downgrade() must undo the upgrade changes (drop columns or drop table).
4. All new columns must have safe defaults (None where nullable, server_default='true' for voice_enabled).
5. Include created_at and updated_at columns with server_default=func.now() if creating a new table.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- migrations/versions/ to find the current head revision and migration patterns
- chatbot/db/models.py (updated by task r.3) for the exact voice preference column definitions
- migrations/env.py for Alembic configuration

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

IMPORTANT — Verify the real head revision number before writing. The filename 0009_voice_prefs.py is a placeholder. Inspect the existing migrations/versions/ directory to determine the correct next revision sequence number and naming convention. If the highest existing revision uses a different numbering scheme (alembic hex revisions), follow that convention instead.
acceptance_criteria: migrations/versions/0009_voice_prefs.py (or filename matching real head+1) exists
Migration has correct up_revision pointing to the actual head revision
upgrade() adds voice preference columns or creates the voice_preferences table
All new columns have safe defaults
python -m py_compile on the migration file passes
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
